div.head: VI Atr 34
div.ab: K. ⁊ gyf hwa folces fyrdscip awyrde, gebete þæt georne, ⁊ cyninge þa munde; ⁊ gif hit man amyrre, þæt hit ænote weorðe, forgylde hit fullice, ⁊ cyninge þone mundbrice.
⁊ gyf hwa folces fyrdscip awyrde, gebete þæt georne ⁊ cyninge þa munde; ⁊ gif hit man amyrre þæt hit ænote weorðe, forgylde hit fullice ⁊ cyninge þone mundbrice.
And gyf hwa folces fyrdscip awyrde, gebete þæt georne and cyninge þa munde; and gif hit man amyrre þæt hit ænote weorðe, forgylde hit fullice, and cyninge þone mundbrice.

Und wenn einer ein öffentliches Wehrschiff schädigt, büsse er das [Beschädigte] willig, und dem König das [Strafgeld für verletzte] Schutzgewalt; und wenn es zerstört wird, so dass es unbrauchbar wird, bezahle er es vollständig und dem König [Strafgeld für] Schutzgewalt-Verletzung.

And if anyone damages a public warship, let him make good [the damage] willingly, and [pay] the king [the fine for breach of his] protection; and if it is destroyed so that it becomes useless, let him pay for it in full, and [pay] the king [the fine for] breach of protection.

And if anyone damages a national warship, he shall with all diligence make compensation for it, and shall pay to the king the fine due for breach of his “mund”; and if it be destroyed so as to be useless, he shall pay for it in full, and shall give the king the fine due for breach of his “mund.”

And if anyone damages one of the realm’s warships, he is to atone sincerely for that and compensate the king for violating his protection; and if it is destroyed so that it is no longer of any use, he is to make restitution in full and pay the king for the breach of his peace.

note.seg: Mit Unrecht verbindet Price-Thorpe hwa folces ‘jemand im Volke’; denn der Gen. part. pflegt voranzugehen; s. Toller s. v. hwa. Und folc (s. d. Wb 2) heisst in Kompositen öfter: ‘Staat, Nation’; s. Toller folcgestreon

Price-Thorpe wrongly take hwa folces together as ‘anyone among the people’; for the partitive genitive usually comes first; see Toller s. v. hwa. And in compounds folc (see that word in Wb 2) often means ‘state, nation’; see Toller folcgestreon
‘bessere aus’, wie L vielleicht versteht, liesse ein Verb für munde vermissen (doch wäre Ellipse möglich) und gäbe nicht den Ggs. zu ‘entgelte voll’ nächsten Gedankens
‘let him repair’, as L perhaps understands it, would leave munde without a verb (though an ellipsis would be possible) and would not yield the contrast to ‘let him pay in full’ in the next clause

Königs Gefolge und -Dienst, aber auch das Heer als solches, steht unter besonderem Schutz (s. d. Gl 9. c II. III). Hier ist Königsschutz (s. d. Gl 5. 8) = 5 £ gemeint. Diese Strafsumme kommt für Verletzung des Friedens oder der Folgepflicht im Heere (s. d. Gl 8ff.) sonst nicht vor

The king’s retinue and service, but also the army as such, stand under special protection (see that word in Gl 9. c II. III). Here the king’s protection (see that word in Gl 5. 8) = 5 £ is meant. This penalty does not otherwise occur for breach of the peace or of the duty of service in the army (see that word in Gl 8ff.)
munitio (s. Ducange, auch munimen, -itas): ‘Verteidigung, Schutz(brief)’ soll mund übersetzen
munitio (see Ducange, also munimen, -itas): ‘defence, protection (letter of protection)’ is meant to translate mund
This clause is not found in V Atr.
The Latin version reads: Quicunque aliquam ex novibus per quampiam inertiam vel per incuriam vel neglegentiam corruperit.
